description: Publish a custom CloudEvent to an Eventarc channel (default the project's Firebase channel), as getEventarc().channel().publish() does; every matching function runs, and the report says which received it and how each call ended (after waiting about 3 s at most). To deliver a received event again, use eventarc_replay_event.

channel.description: Full channel name or google; default projects/<project>/locations/us-central1/channels/firebase

text.description: Event data as plain text (instead of data)

name: eventarc_publish
